body.name: Directed-rational logged-profile certificate
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Cert}_n\) enumerates rational Lipschitz outer boxes for \(\mathcal Q_n(e)\) and \(\mathcal R\), truncates the Poisson integral near zero with a rational cutoff and a Campbell bound, quantizes time and signed jumps with the common-Poisson Wasserstein bound, truncates the total count with a certified Poisson-tail bound, performs direct directed-rational signed-mark convolution, adds net, quadrature, count, and rounding allowances totaling at most \(\zeta_n\), and returns the smallest rational \(a_n\) whose certificate proves \(\sup_{q'\in\mathcal Q_n(e),r'\in\mathcal R}\mathbb E H_{a_n,h_n}(Z_{r',q'})\le\alpha-\Delta_n\); if \(T_n\le K\), \(\delta_{q,n}>c/4\), the enclosure is empty, or \(\Delta_n\ge\alpha\), it returns the full-range flag.
